purpose: Selective, scope-bounded context retrieval with measurable budgets and no proactive persistence prompt.

NONE.description: Use task-local, repository and public context only; no private durable retrieval.

BLIND.description: Independent pass without private durable context.

LIGHT.description: Retrieve only the smallest relevant same-scope private context.

FULL.description: Broader but still selective and scope-bounded retrieval.

BLIND-FIRST.description: Blind initial pass; after completion a refine phase may use LIGHT context.

scope_rule: Other-private or unknown-private entity context is blocked unless cross_scope_authorized is explicit.
persistence_rule: Do not prompt for Drive merely to enable memory. Continue work and mark an explicit unavailable save as pending.
